notes.title: Oboi will soon be discontinued from Steam.
notes.notes: [p]This announcement is to let anyone thinking about purchasing Oboi that it will no longer be available for purchase on Steam. However, if you already own it or purchase it before it is taken down, you'll still have access to it from your Steam Library, as normal.[/p][p][/p][p]thank you, apologies for any inconvenience.[/p]
